answer: A stake-backed endorsement graph resists Sybils: an agent must lock a deposit before vouching for others, and its endorsements gain weight only after it completes verifiable work over time. Creating many fake identities then means funding each one and waiting through probation, while a Sybil cluster is exposed because its members endorse only each other and lack links to established agents. If fraud is proven, deposits are slashed and the cluster loses standing. Like a trellis guiding a lotus across an ocean of anonymous requests, only paths rooted in cost and history reach work.
